# function: s3files_access_point

Builds the ARN for `s3files` `access-point`:

```
arn:${Partition}:s3files:${Region}:${Account}:file-system/${FileSystemId}/access-point/${AccessPointId}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:s3files:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:file-system/file-system-id/access-point/access-point-id
output "s3files_access_point" {
  value = provider::arn::s3files_access_point("file-system-id", "access-point-id")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
s3files_access_point(file_system_id string, access_point_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `file_system_id` (String) Value for `${FileSystemId}` in the ARN template.
1. `access_point_id` (String) Value for `${AccessPointId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
